body:
Every compiled LO program used to be a single, self-contained, zero-
parameter computation -- a bare top-level Lambda emitted a PARENA fn VALUE
(invalid as a defn body), so nothing LO compiled could be invoked with a
real runtime argument.

Fixed: a bare top-level Lambda now emits a real, exported, parameterized
defn, reusing the existing Call-wrapped case's own parameter-binding
scheme. Live-verified end to end: compiled through parena build + cc,
invoked from a real Go test driver with two different runtime arguments,
both correct.

This closes NORTHSTAR.md's own DUNG-integration gap #2. Gap #1 (mod-4
arithmetic, by design) still stands -- only a naturally 4-valued slice of
host logic is a real LO/DUNG fit today.

Full suite green. Commit: LO 71218fc.

⚓ ☃
title: Closed the top-level-Lambda runtime-argument gap (NORTHSTAR DUNG-integration gap #2)
